definition: A reusable arrangement without independent adoption or semantic authority.
A typed behavior required or offered across a boundary.
A subsystem without its own full product promise.
An observed provider artifact that owns no canonical meaning.
A provider-independent reusable semantic or effect-bound seam.
A separate bounded context imported through an explicit contract.
An independently adopted and operated outcome promise with support and exit.
Owner of one meaning, lifecycle, invariants and refusals.
An exact external edition specializing a contract.
Packaging of multiple products and capabilities.
